brief:
Adham Heriz, 41, recovered the remains of his wife nearly three years after an Israeli bombing, Middle East Eye reported. Heriz had been waiting to retrieve and bury the bodies of his wife and children following the strike.

The recovery came after an extended delay in accessing the remains, marking a conclusion to years of separation from his family members killed in the attack.
dek: Three years after Israeli bombing, Palestinian man recovers wife's remains For nearly three years, Adham Heriz, 41, waited to recover and bury the bodies of his wife and children.
title: Palestinian man recovers wife's remains three years after Israeli bombing
